prompt: Bring this painted neon city on Mars to life: the glowing light trails flow smoothly along their curves like streams of light, city windows and neon signs gently flicker, the stars twinkle, the red planet glows softly. The camera is completely still (tripod, locked-off): the cliffs, buildings, planet, moon and horizon do not move at all; only the lights, water, sky and particles move. Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Do NOT add any new objects, characters, vehicles, text or UI. Seamless gentle ambient motion that can loop, calm and magical.
